text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: AUTOSCALER_QUEUE_BACKLOG_HIGH (pd-7812). Severity: P1. Threshold: queue_depth > 20k for 5m. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/autoscaler-queue-backlog

pagerduty: pd-7812 assigned to oncall-sre

julia: seeing the page, joining. queue depth ~37,100 across inference-cell-us-west-2, 95th latency jumped to 3.2s.

alex: acked. I'm on call, starting triage. pinging infra for nodepool provisioning errors.

maria: quick snapshot from metrics: 
- desired replicas (inference-scaler): 12
- actual pods ready: 3 (crashed/pending 9)
- underlying nodes: nodepool-provisioner returning 429 / quota errors

lee: I see AWS autoscaling errors in the control plane: 
```
ERROR ProvisionNodeGroup: CreateLaunchTemplate error: RequestLimitExceeded: Request would exceed quota
```
Looks like provider quota + provisioning latency.

alex: can we temporarily scale down low-priority batch routes and move them to the warm pool? want to free capacity and reduce autoscaler pressure.

maria: yes. prepping a patch to route batch->fallback-model and lower concurrency for non-prod tenants.

ops-shift: customer-impact check: enterprise customers on dedicated capacity may see increased latency; CS team notified and creating ticket.

cs-rep: created Zendesk ticket ZD-4021 for customer A; alerted account owner.

alex: attempting manual scale of nodepool as workaround. running: 
```
aws eks update-nodegroup-config --cluster-name redwood-prod --nodegroup-name inference-hot-2 --scaling-config minSize=4,maxSize=50,desiredSize=20
```
Waited 90s — API returning quota error.

lee: alternate: try spinning up spot fallback pool in a different AZ and attach to nodegroup: 
```
eksctl create nodegroup --cluster redwood-prod --name fallback-az-c --node-type g5.xlarge --nodes 6 --asg-access
```
If that fails, we should scale deployment replicas down to reduce demand.

alex: patching inference-router to route model-small for low priority: 
```
kubectl patch deploy inference-router -n prod --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/2/value","value":"model-small"}]'
```
Applying now.

julia: confirmed routing change applied. low-priority traffic is backfilled to model-small. queue depth dropped to ~28k in 7m.

sre-bot: PagerDuty pd-7812 updated: escalation timer paused (ack by alex).

maria: still seeing 6 pods stuck in Pending with reason ImagePullBackOff and a couple stuck on NodeAllocation. Might be kubelet limits + container runtime slow pulls due to registry throttling.

lee: pushing a quick image tag that is already cached on nodes to avoid long pulls: model-runtime:v2 -> model-runtime:cached-v2.

alex: redeploying warm image tag to pending pods: 
```
kubectl set image deployment/inference-worker inference-worker=model-runtime:cached-v2 -n prod
```
Pods restarting...

ops-shift: CS reports degraded performance but no functional errors for 90% of active sessions. Critical tenant saw 15% request slowdowns; mitigation notes added to ticket.

maria: good sign — pending pods now transitioning Ready. queue depth back to 9,200 after 18m total. 95th latency down to 1.1s.

alex: manual nodegroup spin-up eventually succeeded in fallback AZ. added +6 nodes. That plus routing changes closed the backlog.

pagerduty: pd-7812 acknowledged by alex at 1799990060.

julia: did we miss any automatic fallback in the scaling policy? autoscaler should have provisioned earlier; need to capture root cause.

lee: hypothesis: provider quota throttling + image pull latency combined to stall scaling loop; autoscaler kept request rate but nodes didn't come up, HPA saw pending pods and couldn't change desired replicas further because max nodes reached in that pool.

alex: created quick rollup: create follow-up ticket in SRE backlog for: 
- tighten autoscaler fallback to cross-AZ fallback pool (action: eng-infra)
- add registry image-caching for critical runtime images (action: eng-runtime)
- improve incident runbook to include manual-route-to-fallback steps (action: eng-oncall)

ops-shift: CS updated customers in impacted orgs. No escalations so far.

sre-bot: pd-7812 resolved by alex at 1799990540. Closing page.

julia: thanks team — filing postmortem template and scheduling oncall + infra sync. Marking action items and owners. :white_check_mark:
